module_summary: Ethernet RX pause controller: decodes received MAC control frames by opcode, loads LFC and 8 PFC quanta timers, and asserts pause requests until timers expire.

anchors.name: mcf_valid
anchors.why: Received MAC control frame strobe triggering opcode decode and quanta reload.

anchors.name: mcf_opcode
anchors.why: Frame opcode compared against LFC/PFC configured opcodes to select pause type.

anchors.name: mcf_params
anchors.why: Frame parameters carrying pause quanta and PFC class-enable vector.

anchors.name: lfc_quanta_reg
anchors.why: LFC pause timer loaded from frame, decremented by quanta step on ack.

anchors.name: pfc_quanta_reg
anchors.why: Per-priority PFC pause timers, eight entries, drive pfc request bits.

anchors.name: rx_lfc_req
anchors.why: Link pause request asserted while LFC quanta timer nonzero and enabled.

anchors.name: rx_lfc_ack
anchors.why: Pause acknowledged; enables LFC quanta timer decrement.

anchors.name: rx_pfc_req
anchors.why: Per-priority pause request vector from nonzero PFC timers.

anchors.name: rx_pfc_ack
anchors.why: Per-priority acknowledge enabling PFC timer decrement.

anchors.name: cfg_rx_lfc_opcode
anchors.why: Configured LFC opcode matched against incoming frame opcode.

anchors.name: cfg_rx_lfc_en
anchors.why: Enables LFC frame decode and LFC request generation.

anchors.name: cfg_rx_pfc_opcode
anchors.why: Configured PFC opcode matched against incoming frame opcode.

anchors.name: cfg_rx_pfc_en
anchors.why: Enables PFC frame decode and PFC request bits.

anchors.name: cfg_quanta_step
anchors.why: Amount subtracted from quanta timers each quanta clock tick.

anchors.name: cfg_quanta_clk_en
anchors.why: Quanta time-base tick enabling timer decrement.

anchors.name: stat_rx_lfc_pkt_reg
anchors.why: Registered pulse flagging a received LFC pause frame.

anchors.name: stat_rx_lfc_xon_reg
anchors.why: Registered pulse for LFC frame with zero quanta (XON).

anchors.name: stat_rx_pfc_pkt_reg
anchors.why: Registered pulse flagging a received PFC frame.

anchors.name: stat_rx_pfc_xon_reg
anchors.why: Per-priority XON pulse vector from PFC frame parameters.

groups.name: Control frame decoder
groups.description: Matches frame opcode to LFC/PFC config and extracts pause quanta.

groups.name: LFC pause timer
groups.description: Link pause quanta countdown driving rx_lfc_req until expiry.

groups.name: PFC pause timers
groups.description: Eight per-priority quanta countdowns driving rx_pfc_req bits.

groups.name: Quanta time base
groups.description: Tick enable and step size for decrementing all pause timers.

groups.name: Status pulses
groups.description: Registered per-frame packet, XON and XOFF statistics strobes.
